facts.fact: Minister of state for ICT Godfrey Kabbyanga Baluku said the government's suspension of Facebook, in place since January 2021, will be maintained until Meta meets government conditions; the platform is reachable mainly through VPNs.
Rights groups including Unwanted Witness and Amnesty International criticised the continued Facebook suspension, arguing it limits freedom of expression and political participation.
